title: Clippy -D warnings fails on non-Windows: exchange execute functions are async with no await off Windows
outcome: Clippy -D warnings fails on non-Windows: exchange execute functions are async with no await off Windows
acceptance: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes for a non-Windows target (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) on the fixed tree, shown by a recorded run (Linux/WSL or cross-target check), with no #[allow] or cfg_attr allow of clippy::unused_async added.

execute and execute_config keep their Windows behaviour (the Windows exchange tests pass in the full gate) and their non-Windows path still returns RunError::UnsupportedPlatform, shown by the cross-target Clippy type-check plus an unchanged unsupported-platform code path

completion.summary: Non-Windows clippy -D warnings no longer fails with clippy::unused_async in exchange/mod.rs. A cfg(not(windows)) `mod process` stand-in with the Windows signature returns a ready UnsupportedPlatform future and never launches the command. execute and execute_config await it on every platform, with no lint suppression and Windows behaviour unchanged. The non-Windows test also covers execute_config. Evidence: a cross-target Linux clippy on the final tree (launcher run test-899e8340, input dc95f6e9), with a control that reproduced Greg's error on the unfixed base; full gate test-14cce9e5 12/12; three clean Codex+Claude review rounds; evaluation 2c069de4 and closure evaluation 2a16b721, both 2/2. Landed as da82b38 and installed as build 161a07236b34; all six live stores ready.
